name: BGMC International Ltd.
summary: BGMC International Limited, founded in 1996 and headquartered in Subang Jaya, Malaysia, is an investment holding company providing construction services in Malaysia through four segments: building and structures, energy infrastructure, mechanical and electrical, and earthworks and infrastructure. It builds residential and commercial properties, factories and government projects, designs power substations, installs underground cabling, and develops utility-scale solar plants. It also supplies elevators and invests in property.
